{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "72fc8ccb",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Univariate data - Plots"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "99172cd5",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "This tutorial covers the built-in visuals of the `Univar` object: the standard view, the available layouts, the options for the data panel, fine-tuning and saving figures.\n",
    "\n",
    "```{seealso}\n",
    "Check out the {doc}`Univariate data - Basics <univar_01>` tutorial first.\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "db0750f5",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Notebook setup\n",
    "\n",
    "For users running this tutorial as a Jupyter Notebook, this cell must be executed first:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "62a7ce98",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T22:26:20.402675Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T22:26:20.402020Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.126148Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.125415Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": "Outputs will be saved to: ./outputs\\univariate\n"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import sys\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "# Install `plans` in `google.colab`.\n",
    "# Use `pip install plans` for other environments.\n",
    "\n",
    "if \"google.colab\" in sys.modules:\n",
    "    import os\n",
    "    os.system(f\"{sys.executable} -m pip install -q plans\")\n",
    "\n",
    "from plans.datasets.analyst import Univar\n",
    "\n",
    "# This avoids warnings related to uninstalled fonts\n",
    "import logging\n",
    "# Set the matplotlib font manager logger to only show errors (hides warnings)\n",
    "logging.getLogger('matplotlib.font_manager').setLevel(logging.ERROR)\n",
    "\n",
    "# define output folder\n",
    "OUTPUT_DIR = Path(\"outputs/univariate\")\n",
    "OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "print(f\"Outputs will be saved to: ./{OUTPUT_DIR}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "2f03d95d",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Sample data\n",
    "\n",
    "Lets make a skewed sample, like daily discharge: most values are low, with a few high ones. Set the variable name and units **before** setting the data, so they are used as labels. The `.set_array()` method takes a `numpy` array directly:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "d4751685",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.129340Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.129049Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.141281Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.140661Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "rng = np.random.default_rng(seed=1)  # ensure reproducibility\n",
    "v = rng.gamma(shape=2, scale=10, size=500)\n",
    "\n",
    "unv = Univar(name=\"Discharge\", alias=\"Q\")\n",
    "unv.varname = \"Discharge\"\n",
    "unv.units = \"m3/s\"\n",
    "unv.set_array(array=v)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "5fffe997",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Standard visualization\n",
    "\n",
    "Get the standard visual using the `.view()` method. The `full` layout shows the data points (in their original order), the histogram, the CDF (as exceedance probability) and a table of basic statistics:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "43dd5077",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.144649Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.144418Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.556089Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.555445Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "metadata": {},
     "data": {
      "text/plain": "<Figure size 708.661x472.441 with 3 Axes>",
      "image/png": ""
     }
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "unv.view()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "aae16226",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Layouts"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "8a3b21b2",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "List available layout keys:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "9249a97e",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.559666Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.559443Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.563374Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.562818Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": "dict_keys(['full', 'mini', 'simple', 'simple-shallow', 'qq', 'default'])\n"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "print(unv.layouts.keys())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "6a96c7b9",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The `mini` layout drops the statistics table:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "7b02d252",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.566944Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.566732Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.742038Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.741315Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "metadata": {},
     "data": {
      "text/plain": "<Figure size 708.661x354.331 with 3 Axes>",
      "image/png": ""
     }
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "unv.view_specs[\"layout\"] = \"mini\"\n",
    "unv.view()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "c5c03f00",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The `simple` layouts show the data panel only:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "31fdb27e",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.744224Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.743999Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.813078Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.812282Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "metadata": {},
     "data": {
      "text/plain": "<Figure size 478.346x472.441 with 1 Axes>",
      "image/png": ""
     }
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "unv.view_specs[\"layout\"] = \"simple\"\n",
    "unv.view()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "5a8e3456",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.816318Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.816068Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.873534Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.872620Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "metadata": {},
     "data": {
      "text/plain": "<Figure size 478.346x177.165 with 1 Axes>",
      "image/png": ""
     }
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "unv.view_specs[\"layout\"] = \"simple-shallow\"\n",
    "unv.view()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a1f0c2d4",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The `qq` layout is a Q-Q plot, which compares the data with a normal distribution. Points on the line follow the normal distribution of same mean and standard deviation. This skewed sample bends away from the line, mainly at the high values:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "b2e1d3c5",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "metadata": {},
     "data": {
      "text/plain": "<Figure size 478.346x472.441 with 1 Axes>",
      "image/png": ""
     }
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "unv.view_specs[\"layout\"] = \"qq\"\n",
    "unv.view()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "6043d719",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Data panel: scatter or boxplot\n",
    "\n",
    "The data panel shows a scatter of the data points by default. Set `view_specs[\"data_plot\"]` to `\"boxplot\"` for a boxplot instead. The box spans the first to the third quartile, with the median in black. Whiskers reach 1.5 times the interquartile range, and values beyond them are drawn as dots:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "265adfa7",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.876852Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T22:26:21.876450Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T22:26:22.075420Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T22:26:22.074618Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "metadata": {},
     "data": {
      "text/plain": "<Figure size 708.661x472.441 with 3 Axes>",
      "image/png": ""
     }
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "unv.view_specs[\"layout\"] = \"full\"\n",
    "unv.view_specs[\"data_plot\"] = \"boxplot\"\n",
    "unv.view()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ec332072",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Hide the outlier dots with `box_showfliers`, and add the mean line with `plot_mean_data`. For skewed data, the mean sits above the median, pulled up by the high values:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "d5706e8f",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T22:26:22.078855Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T22:26:22.078560Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T22:26:22.564788Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T22:26:22.563035Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "metadata": {},
     "data": {
      "text/plain": "<Figure size 708.661x472.441 with 3 Axes>",
      "image/png": ""
     }
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "unv.view_specs[\"box_showfliers\"] = False\n",
    "unv.view_specs[\"plot_mean_data\"] = True\n",
    "unv.view()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "03880078",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Colorized scatter\n",
    "\n",
    "Back to the scatter, the data points can be colored by classes of value. The `scheme_cmap` key sets how classes are defined: `equal` for classes of equal width, or `quantiles` for classes with the same number of values. The `n_classes_cmap` key sets how many classes, five by default:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "188189c6",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T22:26:22.570543Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T22:26:22.569660Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T22:26:23.142153Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T22:26:23.139344Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "metadata": {},
     "data": {
      "text/plain": "<Figure size 708.661x472.441 with 3 Axes>",
      "image/png": ""
     }
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "unv.view_specs[\"data_plot\"] = \"scatter\"\n",
    "unv.view_specs[\"plot_mean_data\"] = False\n",
    "unv.view_specs[\"colorize_scatter\"] = True\n",
    "unv.view_specs[\"scheme_cmap\"] = \"quantiles\"\n",
    "unv.view_specs[\"cmap\"] = \"viridis\"\n",
    "unv.view()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "2671e479",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Fine-tuning visuals\n",
    "\n",
    "Use the `.view_specs` keys for fine tuning the visual. Example of some possibilities:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "id": "150051a7",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T22:26:23.149084Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T22:26:23.148115Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T22:26:23.769623Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T22:26:23.767976Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "metadata": {},
     "data": {
      "text/plain": "<Figure size 708.661x472.441 with 3 Axes>",
      "image/png": ""
     }
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "unv.view_specs[\"colorize_scatter\"] = False\n",
    "# Y axis range\n",
    "unv.view_specs[\"range\"] = [0, 120]\n",
    "# Scatter\n",
    "unv.view_specs[\"scatter_factor\"] = 2  # occupy more space\n",
    "# Color\n",
    "unv.view_specs[\"color\"] = \"blue\"\n",
    "unv.view_specs[\"color_hist\"] = \"green\"\n",
    "# Decorations\n",
    "unv.view_specs[\"plot_mean\"] = False\n",
    "unv.view_specs[\"plot_mean_data\"] = True\n",
    "unv.view_specs[\"title\"] = \"Hello! This is a tutorial!\"\n",
    "# call view again\n",
    "unv.view()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "fd3d26c6",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Check out all keys available in `.view_specs`:"
   ]
  },
  {

   "execution_count": 12,

   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T22:26:23.774126Z",

    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": "['style', 'gs_wspace', 'gs_hspace', 'gs_left', 'gs_right', 'gs_bottom', 'gs_top', 'folder', 'filename', 'fig_format', 'dpi', 'title', 'xvar', 'yvar', 'xlabel', 'ylabel', 'color', 'xmin', 'xmax', 'ymin', 'ymax', 'layout', 'data_plot', 'subtitle_data', 'subtitle_box', 'subtitle_hist', 'subtitle_cdf', 'subtitle_qq', 'yvar_field', 'xlabel_cdf', 'xlabel_qq', 'data_label', 'data_legend', 'color_hist', 'color_cdf', 'color_mean', 'color_mean_text', 'scheme_cmap', 'n_classes_cmap', 'cmap', 'alpha', 'alpha_hist', 'alpha_cdf', 'range', 'range_x', 'plot_mean', 'plot_mean_data', 'linestyle_mean', 'pad_mean', 'plot_mean_label', 'hist_density', 'bins', 'bins_density', 'ax_data', 'ax_hist', 'ax_cdf', 'x_stats', 'x_stats_sep', 'y_stats', 'zorder_data', 'zorder_histh', 'zorder_cdf', 'scatter_factor', 'colorize_scatter', 'box_width', 'box_showfliers']\n"

    "print(list(unv.view_specs.keys()))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "563dcecf",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Saving figures\n",
    "\n",
    "Set the output folder, file name, format and resolution in `.view_specs`, and call `.view(show=False)` to save the figure instead of showing it:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "id": "625a2e45",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T22:26:23.784842Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T22:26:23.784608Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T22:26:24.254168Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T22:26:24.252678Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": "[WindowsPath('outputs/univariate/discharge.png')]\n"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "unv.view_specs[\"folder\"] = str(OUTPUT_DIR)\n",
    "unv.view_specs[\"filename\"] = \"discharge\"\n",
    "unv.view_specs[\"fig_format\"] = \"png\"\n",
    "unv.view_specs[\"dpi\"] = 300\n",
    "unv.view(show=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(list(OUTPUT_DIR.glob(\"discharge.*\")))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ebf57a9e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "To further customize a figure with `matplotlib`, get the figure object itself with `.view(return_fig=True)`."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "8935e79b",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Recap\n",
    "\n",
    "- `.view()` draws the standard visual; `view_specs[\"layout\"]` switches between `full`, `mini`, `simple`, `simple-shallow` and `qq`.\n",
    "- `view_specs[\"data_plot\"]` sets the data panel as a `scatter` or a `boxplot`.\n",
    "- All other options, including saving, are keys in `.view_specs`."
   ]
  }
 ],
